reason: The plugin is primarily a utility for formatting time durations into readable output, evidenced by its name, description, and README wording about converting milliseconds/seconds into hours/minutes/seconds; available metadata also shows it is packaged as a local DSH plugin with no documented network/dependency on external services, so a low-risk data-processing utility classification is appropriate.

Provides a local utility function-style capability within the DSH plugin ecosystem without documented external integrations.
